sources.title: ThrustCurve.org public-domain motor simulator files
sources.license_policy: Only records whose download API reports license=PD may be packaged without further review.
sources.notes: Imported 596 public-domain RASP/RockSim sample curves through scripts/import_thrustcurve_pd.py. The API exposes RASP/RockSim simulator files and sample pairs. Records marked free, other, unknown, or missing a license require manual provenance review before packaging.

sources.title: NASA NTRS public/export-clear thrust curves digitized from plotted figures
sources.license_policy: Only public NASA NTRS records marked NO ITAR/NO EAR and permitting public/government public use are included. Source PDFs and rendered plot images are not redistributed.
sources.digitization_method: Manual WebPlotDigitizer-style curve extraction from rendered PDF figures using calibrated plot axes. Each curve has a sidecar JSON with source figure, uncertainty, columns, and validation notes.
